summary: If your salary includes a house rent allowance and you actually pay rent for a home you do not own, part of that allowance is not taxed. The exempt part is the least of three limits, so raising one of them alone often changes nothing.

routes.name: Pay rent for a home you do not own, while your salary includes HRA
routes.description: Rent you actually pay, for the period you live in the home, set against the allowance you receive.

disqualifiers.description: Not available in the default regime.
You own the home you live in, or you do not actually pay rent for it.
Only the period you actually lived in the rented home counts, not the whole year.
